provenance: Rule 20.3. Transcribed from the data card image described in docs/research/2026-09-07_RV-1_counters_charts.md section 7.2.
Odds are attack firepower to defense firepower, rounded down in favor of the defender (rule 20.3 examples: 6 to 4 is 3-2, 11 to 4 is 2-1, 4 to 15 is 1-4). A ratio below 1-4 uses the 1-5+ column.
The kill number is the highest adjusted dice roll that eliminates the attacked units.
The project writes this table in its own layout (SR-07).
